digest.component_or_area: IAM access control for review-bot container
propositions: The review-bot container requires IAM permissions to invoke Bedrock's Converse API via an instance role, not long-lived API keys
The Converse API authorizes against the bedrock:InvokeModel action, not bedrock:Converse (proven by runtime AccessDeniedException when only Converse was granted)
IMDS is reachable from containers on the host (evidenced by opcert's working SSM fetch), so the grant is IAM-only with no hop-limit contingency needed

Cross-region inference profiles require both foundation-model ARNs and inference-profile ARNs with wildcarded regions; pinning region or profile prefix to us-east-1 or us. would silently deny valid global profiles
The policy must be added to a new infra/terraform/iam_s7.tf file without modifying iam.tf to uphold the single-owner contract declared at iam.tf:4-9
